qualification: local pinned-fixture correctness and production-admission evidence; not hardware, cross-host, G1-G5, or release qualification

admission.boundedRule: Tier one admits only a register-indexed qword BT block beginning at the measured fixture RIP with RDX as its index. The same operation at another RIP declines.
admission.implementation: The signed bit index selects a qword before or after the ModRM address with arithmetic shift, then a bit within that qword. One restartable read completes before CF is replaced; the following JB consumes the materialized carry image natively.
admission.deferred: All modifying register-indexed memory bit operations and all unmeasured sites remain on their prior path.

verification.focusedGate: 217 tests in DoryARM64BaselineJITTests, DoryARM64Tier1JITTests, DoryX86BitTestAddressingTests, and DoryX86IRTests passed.
verification.dbtAndPCGate: 1,447 tests in 171 suites passed; the pinned PVH environment test skipped because its environment variables were absent.
verification.differentialCoverage: Indices 0, 63, 64, -1, and -65 match the interpreter for clear and set bits, including exact taken and not-taken JB destinations.
verification.rollbackCoverage: An out-of-range adjusted read exits to the interpreter without publishing flags, RIP, registers, or memory.

unmatchedPriorRunComparison.interpretation: The executions have different interrupt, compilation, trace, address-space, and instruction totals. The elapsed difference is reported for completeness and is not a performance claim.

nextVisibleKernelSites.runtimeInterpretation: The retained block is one byte, so the live alternative-patched instruction must be captured before selecting an admission rule.

interpretation: The measured register-indexed memory BT site is absent from the retained negative-cache sample and the authenticated workload completes. A05.2 remains open because 128,462 of 227,352 full-run tier-one attempts still decline.
limitations: The complete workload evidence contains one candidate run on one local Apple M2 Pro.
The negative-cache sampler is capped and proves absence only from the retained visible list.
This evidence establishes no performance delta and does not satisfy G1-G5.
